g.text: ESPHome Craftmade Ceiling Fan & Light RF Gateway
Dual-Control Bridge: Home Assistant Integration with Concurrent Physical Remote Operation
• TX Pin: GPIO21 (D3) via GDO0 (100% duty)
The physical wall remote and Home Assistant operate simultaneously
with zero interference and no changes to household muscle memory.
Wi-Fi modem sleep + CC1101 idle state keep gateway draw <15mA,
waking instantly (<10ms) when automated commands arrive.
Craftmade 303.875 MHz RF Gateway | Seeed Studio XIAO ESP32-C6 + CC1101 | ESPHome 2026
